name: Kasama Hinano
source:
Likes: Doing all kinds of exercise, daydreaming
Dislikes: Sour foods

Shun's childhood friend and classmate who is popular with her peers because of her bubbly personality. She has liked him for a long time and was waiting for their relationship deepen even further, before becoming more aggressive in her pursuit after [url=/c119867]Ena[/url]'s confession. Although she's interested in perverted things, she isn't good at talking about them and can easily get overwhelmed.
